messages:
simon: Quick Q 34 1: Weve got an IC -> Senior IC promotion + relocation to UK. Payroll cutoff is Tue EOD, can we get comp+retro in this cycle?

maya: Hi @simon 1: short answer: maybe. Must have intake form + manager justification + proposed effective date + comp signoff + market check before cutoff. Open the promotions intake and tag me. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/promotions-intake

simon: What exact fields do payroll need for UK relocation? Any extras vs US?

jess: UK specifics: set tax_jurisdiction=UK in HRIS ticket, attach P45 if they have one, confirm NI number when available. No automatic gross-ups unless recruiting flags. For equity: create grant request to stock-admin; they need approvals and FSIN (formal signoff).

oliver-bot: payroll notice: payroll bundle closes in ~28 hours (1776630000). Items after cutoff go to next run.

maya: If you want retro in this run we need everything done and approvals in Slack before cutoff. Acceptable evidence block (paste into intake):

```
- 2 bullets: impact & stretch
- New responsibilities aligned to band rubric
- Market comp note (1-pg)
- Manager approval: simon@redwood.com
```

maya: Also include preferred effective date (we usually use 1st of month or employee local start date). If comp change >10% cc finance for approval.

simon: If effective date is mid-month in UK, will payroll handle tax differences? Any retro tax issues?

jess: UK payroll treats tax cumulatively. Mid-month moves are fine; payroll will prorate gross. Retro pay is possible but may change tax withholdings; payroll will calculate. For statutory holiday accruals, comp changes don't usually change prior accruals. If unusual, mark ticket with "escalate-to-comp".

simon: Equity timeline? Need grant ready before we notify the employee.

jess: Stock-admin SLA ~10 business days after complete grant request + approvals. If you need acceleration, include business justification and cc stock-admin.

maya: Steps for you: 1) fill intake form and paste evidence block, 2) set tax_jurisdiction: UK and attach any P45/NI notes, 3) choose effective date & retro preference, 4) cc finance if >10% comp change. Ill triage immediately once submitted.

simon: Filing now 1: will ping if cutoff gets tight. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks 1: if urgent ping me and Ill expedite. :sparkles:
